verdict.rationale: Two independent probes confirm ente.com serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing Ente's apps, including two-factor authentication codes, so an agent can be pointed at it. The llms.txt is company-wide rather than Auth-specific, and the markdown docs probe returned 404. Missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (help/auth .md returned 404), evidence that the llms.txt covers Auth help content in depth, hands-on corroboration of agent use.
